fix_subject: Consider casts from floating point values to BIGNUM as casts that can fail
pr_title: Merge #26627: Consider casts from floating point values to BIGNUM as casts that can fail

labels.summary: Casting NaN or infinite FLOAT/DOUBLE values to BIGNUM threw an error that surfaced as an internal error, because the cast was wrongly treated as one that cannot fail; it is now marked as a cast that can throw.
